name: mtp-fence-pinret-887a929c9-tc-hm0-portable
purpose: Exact default-off PINRET: ready pins touch only output-valid and returned-credit flops; local G32 load replicas drive output registers, delayed return retires reserved FIFO head. +2 output edges; max one output beat/4cycles. Frame360x360 for legal pin banks; pinned row/site cells held FIRM through DPL, released POST_DETAIL_PLACE. Fullwidth transaction+stalled/visibility order gate and credit-return mutants before adoption. Portable source runner grep replaces absent EPYC3 rg; original four-seed simulations PASS but shell RC1 failure preserved. No RTL/clock/physical design changes to a36 candidate.
